title: The Classic Suite
description:
Welcome to The George – A Newly Renovated Stay in Downtown Klamath Falls

Experience a thoughtfully updated unit in one of Klamath Falls’ historic downtown buildings. The George blends classic character with modern upgrades, offering a comfortable and convenient stay for travelers passing through or working remotely.

Perfect for traveling professionals, couples, and guests looking for a clean, well-equipped place to stay in a central location.

Location Highlights
• Located in the heart of downtown Klamath Falls
• Walking distance to restaurants, shops, and the Amtrak station
• Ideal for exploring the area or commuting locally

The Space
This historic building (nearly 100 years old) has been extensively updated, with renovated units designed for comfort and functionality.

Each unit includes:
• Air conditioning and heating
• Fast, free WiFi (great for remote work)
• 55” TVs in the living room and bedroom (for one-bedroom units)
• Microwave and coffee maker (coffee provided)
• Greystone bath amenities
• Comfortable furnishings and modern finishes

Additional Amenities
• On-site laundry (2nd floor, $2 per load – detergent provided)
• Stocked with paper goods and essentials for a convenient stay
• Easy self check-in

The Building
The George is a professionally managed property with a mix of long-term residents and short-term guests. It’s an active downtown setting, giving you a true local experience while staying in a well-maintained environment.

Nearby Favorites
Some great spots just steps away:
• Rodeo’s Pizza – right next door
• A Leap of Taste – local lunch favorite
• Thai Orchid Café – lunch or dinner
• Green Blade Bakery – coffee & pastries
• Basin Martini Bar – dinner & drinks
• The Pikey – casual food & bar

A grocery store (Holiday Market) is just a couple blocks away for anything you need during your stay.

title: The George Suite
tagline: A refurbished retreat in the heart of downtown
description:
Welcome to ‘The George’, a newly refurbished retreat nestled in the heart of vibrant downtown Klamath Falls. Our historic yet extensively modernized building offers a sophisticated blend of classic charm and contemporary convenience, perfect for both passing travelers and remote working professionals.

Occupying an ideal location in downtown Klamath Falls, 'The George' offers easy access to local restaurants, shops, and the Amtrak station, all within walking distance. It's an excellent base for those looking to explore the local area or commute within the city.

Our meticulously renovated units prioritize comfort, practicality, and style. Enjoy a suite of amenities including air-conditioning, lightning-fast Wi-Fi, large-screen TVs in the living area and bedroom, convenient kitchen appliances, and premium Greystone bath products. The units offer a harmonious blend of plush furnishings and sleek modern finishes to ensure a comfortable stay.

In addition to the in-unit amenities, we also provide on-site laundry facilities, easy self-check-in, and a stock of household essentials for your convenience. Our top-tier management ensures that both our long-term residents and short-term guests enjoy a seamless stay in a well-curated and maintained environment.

Immerse yourself in the local life with a host of nearby favorites. Indulge in delicious pizza at Rodeo's, located just next door, enjoy a hearty lunch at 'A Leap of Taste', savor Thai delicacies at 'Thai Orchid Café', or kickstart your day with a hot coffee from 'Green Blade Bakery'. Wind down your day with dinner and drinks at 'Basin Martini Bar' or enjoy a relaxed evening at 'The Pikey' bar. Need groceries? The local 'Holiday Market' is just a couple of blocks away.

Choose 'The George' for an unparalleled mix of comfort, convenience, and local immersion in Klamath Falls.
